ambient-take-your-pick.use_when: Long-form reflective or contemplative pieces; a wide, unobtrusive bed.
ambient-take-your-pick.avoid_when: Anything with a punchy intro or a clear climax you do not want underneath the voice.
ambient-take-your-pick.note: Very low dynamics (flat master) - sits predictably under narration.

cheerful-moments-nekzlo.use_when: Light, friendly explainers and onboarding-style walkthroughs.
cheerful-moments-nekzlo.note: Quietest of the upbeat set - will sit noticeably lower than happy-rainbow under the same bed level.

cheerful-smile-ikson.use_when: Optimistic progress/announcement videos; upbeat without being frantic.

chill-slow-times-over-here.use_when: Slow-burn, thoughtful, long runtime (>=280s) - rare in this library, so it usually does NOT need looping.
chill-slow-times-over-here.avoid_when: Short cutdowns; you will trim most of it.

classical-gymnopedie-no-3.use_when: Quiet, reflective, philosophical or historical narration; sparse enough to leave room for the voice.
classical-gymnopedie-no-3.note: Quiet master and wide dynamics - may need its bed level raised to stay audible.

dance-wild-pogo.use_when: Rhythmic, energetic montages and upbeat explainers with movement.
dance-wild-pogo.note: Flat, loud master - stays steady under the voice.

electronic-nekozilla.avoid_when: Anything needing a quiet, unobtrusive bed.
electronic-nekozilla.note: Widest dynamics in the library - expect the mix to swell and compete with narration.

emotional-past-life.avoid_when: Anything long - this is the shortest track (117s) and will loop several times.

happy-rainbow.use_when: Bright, celebratory, upbeat conclusions and community-facing content.

kids-twinkle-twinkle.note: Quietest master in the library - inaudible at the default bed level without raising it.

light-gravity.use_when: Default choice for light, breezy technical explainers - loud master keeps it audible under narration.
light-gravity.note: Loudest master in the library: if it feels pushy, lower the bed rather than discarding it.

peaceful-sleeping-sheep.use_when: Calm, meditative, ambient backgrounds; long runtime so no looping needed.

rock-not-the-only-one.use_when: Guitar-driven pieces needing forward momentum and emotional lift.
rock-not-the-only-one.avoid_when: Quiet, contemplative writing - a rock bed under a whisper is wrong.
rock-not-the-only-one.note: Flattest and loudest master; will dominate unless attenuated hard.

upbeat-your-love.use_when: Forward-moving tech explainers and 'the paradigm is changing' narratives; the build-and-drop arc suits a thesis stated early.
upbeat-your-love.avoid_when: Somber material - this is an uplifting major-key track.
upbeat-your-love.note: Does not resolve at the end; when it loops the seam is audible, so prefer it when the runtime divides cleanly or accept the loop point under narration.
